title: Auckland Budget Guide
meta_desc: Visit Auckland on a family budget of $200-$350/day, explore free activities, accommodation options, and find out where to save and splurge with our expert guide
intro: Auckland, New Zealand's largest city, is a fantastic destination for families with its beautiful beaches, islands, and world-class attractions. With some planning, you can have a great time in Auckland without breaking the bank. In this guide, we'll show you how to visit Auckland on a budget of $200-$350 per day for a family of four.

sections.heading: Accommodation Options
sections.body:
Auckland has a wide range of accommodation options to suit all budgets. For a cheap option, consider staying in a hostel or camping ground, with prices starting from around $30 per night for a family room. Mid-range options include apartments and motels, with prices starting from around $150 per night.

Some popular mid-range options include the Auckland Central Apartments and the Takapuna Motor Lodge. If you're looking for a more luxurious option, consider staying in a hotel, with prices starting from around $250 per night.
list: Hostel or camping ground: $30-$50 per night
Mid-range apartment or motel: $150-$250 per night

sections.heading: Free Activities
sections.body:
Auckland has plenty of free activities to keep your family entertained. Some popular options include visiting Mission Bay beach and reserve, taking a walk along Tamaki Drive, and exploring Albert Park and the city gardens.

If you're looking for something a bit more adventurous, consider visiting Tawharanui Regional Park, which is about 45 minutes north of Auckland. This park has a stunning beach with no crowds, even on weekends.

sections.heading: Budget Breakdown
sections.body: To give you a better idea of what to expect, here's a rough breakdown of what a 3-day trip to Auckland might cost for a family of four.

sections.heading: Where to Save and Splurge
sections.body:
To make the most of your budget, consider saving money on accommodation and food, and splurging on activities that are important to you. For example, you could stay in a mid-range apartment and cook some of your own meals, but splurge on a visit to the Sky Tower or a day trip to Waiheke Island.

Some activities, such as visiting the Auckland Zoo or Kelly Tarlton's SEA LIFE Aquarium, are worth splurging on, as they offer a unique and memorable experience for your family.
